{{Money|1,900}} (Group Bonus) |shared_cash = 50% |music-1 = '''Ambient''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Frost Solitude|250px|thumb|center]] |music-2 = '''Final Wave ([[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]])''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Krampus|250px|thumb|center]] |music-3 = '''Ambient ([[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]] Rage)''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Krampus Rage|250px|thumb|center]] |music-ingame-2='''Final Wave ([[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]])''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Krampus's Theme In-Game|250px|thumb|center]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Village of Despair''' was the event [[Maps|map]] for the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. Like other event maps, it had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Upon triumphing, players were rewarded with the [[Frost Blaster]]. You also got {{Tickets|10-50}} per wave completed, which could be used to buy items from the [[Event Store]]. In this map, players started off with {{Money|1,800}} (or {{Money|1,900}} if players were in the community group). ==Design & Path== '''Village of Despair''' took place in, as the name states, a snowy village, separated by a frozen river, creating two islands. The two islands were surrounded by a frozen sea. A railroad ran across the length of the map. Two concrete icy bridges could be seen crossing the river, with one of them carrying the railroad. A sailboat can be seen in the frozen river. A lighthouse and a rocky island could be seen at sea. The first island contained mostly mountainous terrain, with several cliffs for cliff towers to be placed on. However, a few houses could be seen, as well as lanterns that lined the path. A train station and a windmill could also be seen. The second island consisted of more buildings, windmills and Christmas decorations. There was also a toy factory at the end of the map. A large clock tower and windmill could be seen on this island. The dark grey concrete path started from a cave, which had a forcefield wall. It turned around cliffs on the first island and crossed a concrete bridge to reach the second island. On the second island, a large cliff ran perpendicular to the direction of the path, so the path took a long detour around it. At the last part of the path, the path became inclined at some steps so enemies could reach the toy factory's doors. ==Story== '''Village of Despair''', which based on its appearance in the [[Violent Night Event]] trailer is likely located in the North Pole, is invaded by [[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]] and his army. The [[T.D.S. Organization]] sends some of their agents to fight him and eventually defeat him. ==Rewards== The game calculated how much {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Exp|}} and {{Tickets|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (08:00 UTC Friday – 08:00 UTC Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x. Any rewards that end in a decimal point were rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. '''Village of Despair''' rewarded {{Tickets|10-50}} for every wave completed. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="margin:0 auto; text-align: center;" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|18}} × Waves |Waves Completed × {{Exp|2.5}} |} ===Badges=== There were also a few [[badges]] which you could obtain when playing this map during the event, which may have additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. These were: {{Badge |title = Winter 2019 |description = Congrats on defeating Krampus! |rewards = [[Frost Blaster]] |image = WinterBadge.png |obtainable = No }} {{Badge |title = Triumph Village of Despair |image = VoDBadge.png |obtainable = No }} ==Wave Structure== In '''Village of Despair''', the formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|50}} - 5 × (Players - 1)) × Waves Completed The waves in '''Village of Despair''' also followed these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="margin:0 auto; width:50%" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-9 |1:00 |0:20Skip at 0:39. |- |10-12 |2:00 |0:40Skip at 1:19. |- |13-14 |3:00 |1:00Skip at 1:59. |- |15 |166666666666666:40 |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut. ----

==Strategy== *Ideally, you would want people to initially save up for the [[Minigunner]] given that the starting money is quite high. **However, you need to have someone defending while other people are doing this. Using a couple of [[Sniper]]s on the middle hill on the first island, or a couple of [[Soldier]]s is recommended. **The [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] is also quite useful on this map, so long they are placed at the end of a long straight. *The first island should be the initial spot to place towers due to the rotation of the path here. **The [[DJ Booth]] can be used to extend a tower's range to cover the entirety of this part, if required. **A well placed [[Pyromancer]] can slow down enemies down on two separate parts of the path. *There are several cliffs to place down [[Ranger|Outlaws]] and [[Sniper]]s, making them ideal towers. *If enemies manage to leave the first island (which is especially likely for [[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]]), then utilize the second island. **As with the first island, there are plenty of cliff spaces for [[Ranger|Outlaws]]. *[[Farm]]s are useless on this map as they do not grant any additional cash. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Christmas2019Thumb.jpg|'''Village of Despair''' on the game thumbnail. 8abf60fab3040c9dd5fa393fcb7a2899.jpg|'''Village of Despair''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} DefaultMinigunnerGameIcon.png|'''Village of Despair''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} ENTba6nWoAYdvnb.jpg|'''Village of Despair''' on a promotional image. }} ==Trivia== *There was an Easter egg on the second island where a Robloxian (namely [https://www.roblox.com/users/209546354/profile Beefchoplets]) could be seen frozen in ice. *Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], this was one of four maps to have an inclined path, with the others being [[Crossroads]], [[Graveyard]] and [[Rocket Arena]]. **However, this map has the most noticeable incline. ==Update History== *'''24 December 2019''' -
